decisions.reason: A multi-model line with its own website page signals visible commitment and fits the firm's core thermoforming business, so management will persist with it.
The PETG blank has a dedicated page and complements the established thermoforming material range, so dropping it would expose a visible decision with little gain.
The lacquer is only mentioned on the website and reflects modest investment, but it is a low-cost consumable that fits lab workflows, so it is likely retained despite weaker commitment.
The contrast spray is presented on its own page and supports the firm's announced digital scanning direction, which makes its early results easy to attribute to adoption lag.
Custom earmolds are central to the firm's skilled custom-device manufacturing, and as a multi-model line they represent substantial investment, so persistence is likely.
The hearing protection line builds on core earmold capabilities and involved investment in several models, so management would treat weak results as temporary.
